Class RagRetrievalConfig

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.rag.schema.RagRetrievalConfig
public class RagRetrievalConfig extends Object
Strongly-typed DTO for RAG retrieval configuration. Mirrors the fields in tech.kayys.wayang.rag.core.RetrievalConfig.
